name: survey-plate
useFor: Use where a page or shell needs a map picture without loading imagery: a hero, a 404, an auth panel, a dashboard's map panel. Give it a size (an aspect ratio or a height). Parcels and the marker are placed in percent of the plate. In the product, the real map with `map` marks replaces it.
source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): hatched parcels and survey grid (map-shape.css, hero-crosshair.css); Figma map exploration (449:2) for the crosshair
title: Survey plate
description: A drawn survey sheet: contours, a 1px grid with outlined nodes at the crossings, hatched parcels, the chosen parcel in a Forest line, the crosshair marker with its reading, coordinates and a scale.
